questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion to express surprise at a rare occurrence?
options: It was not until he arrived that she realised he had forgotten her birthday.
Only when she had left did he notice the mistake in the document.
Had she known the truth, she would never have trusted him again.
Never have I seen such a level of professionalism in this company’s operations.
questions.answer: Never have I seen such a level of professionalism in this company’s operations.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a cleft construction to highlight the subject of the original sentence?
options: The reason he left was because of the poor management.
What he left was the most valuable asset in the company.
It was the project’s deadline that caused the most tension among staff.
The only thing she regretted was not having asked for more information earlier.
questions.answer: It was the project’s deadline that caused the most tension among staff.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a third conditional with the subjunctive mood to express regret about a past situation?
options: If I had known the risks, I would have taken the job.
If she had been more careful, she wouldn’t have broken her leg.
Had they warned me sooner, I would have avoided the accident.
She wished she could have changed her mind, but it was too late.
questions.answer: If she had been more careful, she wouldn’t have broken her leg.

questions.question: Which sentence uses ellipsis to avoid repetition while maintaining grammatical correctness?
options: The team, along with its members, worked tirelessly to complete the project.
He insisted that we leave immediately; otherwise, we would have missed the flight.
She said she’d be back later, but she never arrived—neither did her explanation.
It was not until after the meeting that they realised their mistake.
questions.answer: She said she’d be back later, but she never arrived—neither did her explanation.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates a formal register with nuanced grammatical choice, avoiding colloquialism?
options: She advised him that he should have consulted the manual before attempting the repair.
He told me it was going to rain, so I brought an umbrella.
The proposal was rejected due to lack of funding, which was unexpected.
They argued that the decision was made without sufficient evidence.
questions.answer: She advised him that he should have consulted the manual before attempting the repair.
